claim: EMGS does the academic check and issues an Approval to Study letter, then sends complete applications to the Student Pass Unit at Immigration headquarters for eVAL approval after travel document and security screening

claim: After eVAL approval, applicants from visa-required countries get a Single Entry Visa through malaysiavisa.imi.gov.my (eVISA cannot be applied for from inside Malaysia)

claim: eVISA applications can be made from anywhere except Malaysia, Israel and North Korea
quote: Permohonan eVISA boleh dibuat dari seluruh dunia, kecuali dari Malaysia, Israel dan Korea Utara

claim: Immigration fees: Student Pass RM60; Long-Term Social Visit Pass for a dependant or guardian RM90; visa at the rate for the applicant's nationality
quote: Pas Pelajar | RM60.00 | | Pas Lawatan (Sosial) Jangka Panjang bagi Tanggungan/Pengiring | RM90.00

quote: a) Suami atau isteri; b) Anak kandung, anak tiri atau anak angkat yang berumur di bawah lapan belas (18) tahun; c) Anak kurang upaya tanpa had umur yang disahkan oleh pengamal perubatan berdaftar; d) Ibu dan bapa kandung; dan e) Ibu dan bapa mertua.

claim: Student Pass holders at language centres, training/skills centres and accredited centres are not eligible to bring dependants
quote: Pemegang Pas Pelajar bagi kategori Pusat Bahasa, Pusat Latihan/Kemahiran dan Pusat Bertauliah TIDAK LAYAK membawa tanggungan.

quote: Tanggungan TIDAK DIBENARKAN bekerja, menjalankan perniagaan, menyampaikan syarahan politik, ucapan, ceramah atau melibatkan diri dalam sebarang aktiviti politik.

quote: Kemudahan bekerja secara sambilan diberikan kepada pemegang Pas Pelajar kategori Universiti Awam (UA) dan Institusi Pengajian Tinggi Swasta (IPTS) tertakluk kepada syarat-syarat berikut: i. Kemudahan ini TIDAK LAYAK DIBERIKAN kepada pemegang Pas Pelajar Pusat Bahasa, Pusat Latihan/Kemahiran dan Pusat Bertauliah

claim: Student Pass holders may work part-time during semester breaks and festive holidays, up to 20 hours a week, only at restaurants, petrol stations, mini markets, hotels and university or college premises

claim: Students may not do front-desk work, and may not act as agents recruiting students
quote: Pelajar tidak dibenarkan menjalankan tugas melibatkan kerja-kerja front desk selaras dengan dasar semasa penggajian pekerja asing; iv. Pelajar juga tidak dibenarkan bertindak sebagai agen pengambilan atau perekrutan pelajar

quote: Permohonan yang lengkap boleh dikemukakan di Unit Pas Pelajar, Bahagian Visa, Pas dan Permit, Ibu Pejabat Imigresen Malaysia / Pejabat Imigresen Negeri dengan mengemukakan dokumen berikut: a) Surat tawaran pekerjaan; b) Surat sokongan daripada institusi yang mengesahkan permohonan kebenaran bekerja serta menyatakan jadual dan tempoh cuti semester; c) Laporan prestasi akademik pelajar/pemohon; d) Laporan kehadiran pelajar/pemohon; e) Salinan pasport pemohon (muka surat biodata dan Pas Pelajar yang masih sah); dan f) Salinan kelulusan yang diperoleh oleh majikan daripada Jabatan Tenaga Kerja selaras dengan peruntukan Seksyen 60K Akta Kerja 1955

claim: The Immigration Department may cancel a Student Pass if the holder breaks any condition or rule
quote: Jabatan Imigresen Malaysia berhak membatalkan Pas Pelajar sekiranya pemegang pas didapati melanggar mana-mana syarat atau peraturan yang ditetapkan.

claim: For the first-year Student Pass sticker the institution submits the original passport, its sticker request letter, EMGS's sticker support letter, the stamped Personal Bond form (new applications) and a Malaysian-recognised health insurance policy covering at least 12 months
quote: Pasport asal pemohon. | | 2. | Surat permohonan pengeluaran pelekat daripada institusi. | | 3. | Surat Sokongan Pengeluaran Pelekat daripada EMGS. | | 4. | Borang Personal Bond yang telah dimatikan setem (permohonan baharu sahaja). | | 5. | Polisi Insurans Kesihatan Malaysia yang diiktiraf di Malaysia dengan tempoh perlindungan sekurang-kurangnya dua belas (12) bulan

claim: A Student Pass renewal application includes the previous semester's academic results and the latest attendance record (among other documents listed on the page)
quote: Keputusan akademik semester terdahulu. | | 8. | Rekod kehadiran terkini.

claim: For a new Student Pass, the passport copy (all pages including the cover) must show at least 18 months' validity
quote: Salinan pasport (semua muka surat termasuk kulit hadapan) dengan tempoh sah laku sekurang-kurangnya lapan belas (18) bulan.

claim: Extra documents requested by EMGS must be submitted within 14 working days of the date EMGS returned the application
quote: Sekiranya dokumen tambahan diperlukan, dokumen tersebut hendaklah dikemukakan dalam tempoh empat belas (14) hari bekerja dari tarikh permohonan dipulangkan oleh EMGS.

claim: Dependants of higher-education Student Pass holders apply through EMGS's STARS system
quote: Bagi tanggungan kepada pemegang Pas Pelajar kategori Institusi Pengajian Tinggi (IPT): Permohonan hendaklah dikemukakan melalui Sistem STARS, Education Malaysia Global Services (EMGS).

claim: Relationship documents are attested by the applicant's own embassy in Malaysia if the applicant is in Malaysia
quote: Pejabat perwakilan / Kedutaan Asing di Malaysia sekiranya pemohon berada di Malaysia

claim: A Student Pass is issued by the Immigration Department and lets an international student stay legally to study at an approved institution
quote: A Student Pass is an immigration pass issued by the Malaysian Immigration Department that allows international students to stay in Malaysia legally for study purposes at an approved educational institution.

claim: Applications go online through the EMGS website, the EMGS HUB mobile app, or by the institution through STARS, after the student accepts the offer
quote: Applications must be submitted online via the EMGS website, the EMGS mobile application (EMGS HUB), or through the education institution via the STARS system (Student Application Registration System) after the student has accepted the offer of admission from the respective institution.

claim: Stages: offer letter; online application to EMGS; academic screening and document checks; eVAL issued; travel; medical screening; passport endorsement
quote: i. Offer Letter issued to the applicant by the institution ii. Online application submission to EMGS iii. Academic screening and document verification iv. Issuance of electronic Visa Approval Letter (eVAL) v. Travel to Malaysia vi. Medical screening vii. Passport endorsement

claim: EMGS's client charter is 14 working days for a complete Student Pass application; incomplete or wrong documents add time
quote: The client charter is 14 working days for a complete application. However, incomplete or incorrect document submissions may result in additional processing time.

claim: The eVAL (electronic Visa Approval Letter) is the Immigration Department's approval issued before entry; a student may enter only after receiving it, not while it is being processed
quote: A student may only enter Malaysia after receiving the eVAL. Entering Malaysia while the eVAL is still being processed is not permitted.

claim: The eVAL is valid for 6 months from the date of issue
quote: The eVAL is valid for six (6) months from the date of issuance.

claim: A Single-Entry Visa (SEV) is required for some nationalities and must be obtained through Malaysia's eVISA system at malaysiavisa.imi.gov.my before travelling
quote: It must be obtained through Malaysia's eVISA system before travelling to Malaysia. Students may apply for an eVISA via: https://malaysiavisa.imi.gov.my/evisa/login.

claim: A student who fails the medical screening can appeal at the same EMGS panel clinic within 3 days of being notified
quote: Students who fail the medical screening may submit an appeal at the same EMGS panel clinic where the screening was conducted. The appeal must be submitted within three (3) days of receiving the notification.

claim: Insurance is compulsory throughout the study period; insurance bought through EMGS covers a new student from the date of entry
quote: For new applications, students who purchase insurance through EMGS will be covered from the date of entry into Malaysia.

claim: A Student Pass is usually issued for up to one year at a time; renewal should be submitted before expiry, ideally 3 months before, to avoid overstaying
quote: The Student Pass is usually issued with a validity of up to one (1) year at a time. Renewal is subject to meeting the required conditions and the approved duration of study.

claim: EMGS recommends submitting the renewal as early as 3 months before the Student Pass expires
quote: EMGS strongly recommends submitting renewal applications as early as three (3) months before expiry.

claim: A course change after getting the Student Pass is possible once through a Variation application within 18 months after the first semester; otherwise the institution shortens the pass with a Check Out Memo and the student must leave Malaysia before reapplying
quote: This option is only applicable once and must be submitted within 18 months after completion of the first semester. If Variation requirements are not met, the student must apply as a new applicant. The institution must shorten the Student Pass (via a Check Out Memo application) and ensure the student exits Malaysia before reapplying for a new eVAL.

claim: A student who entered on an eVAL but has no Student Pass yet and wants another course must leave Malaysia; the institution cancels the eVAL and a new one is applied for
quote: Student entered Malaysia using the eVAL but has not obtained the Student Pass. The student must exit Malaysia.

claim: Variation (change of programme or institution while in Malaysia) needs at least one semester completed, submission within 18 months after the first semester, and enrolment at Bachelor's level or above
quote: Eligibility requirements include: completion of at least one semester of the main programme, application submitted within 18 months after completion of the first semester, and enrolment in a Bachelor's Degree or above programme.

claim: Progression (moving to a higher level, e.g. Bachelor's to Master's) must be submitted within 3 months of completing the previous studies
quote: The Progression application must be submitted within three (3) months from the completion date of the previous studies.

claim: EMGS: postgraduate students can apply for Dependant Passes for husband, wife, children, father, mother, father-in-law and mother-in-law; Bachelor's students only if citizens of a listed country, and Bangladesh is not on the list
quote: i. Postgraduate students are eligible to apply for Dependant Passes. ii. Undergraduate (Bachelor's Degree) students may only apply if they are citizens of the listed countries.
note: Conflicts with S0008 (IMI: dependants only for Master's or PhD). Both exclude Bangladeshi Bachelor's students. Undergraduate list: Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, UAE, Turkey, Qatar, Azerbaijan, Palestinian Territories, Kuwait, Yemen, Iran, Syria, Oman, Jordan, Lebanon, Iraq, Libya, Maldives (table in emgs-faq.txt)

claim: EMGS: international students at public or private higher education institutions may work part-time up to 20 hours a week only during semester breaks or holidays of more than 7 days, at restaurants, petrol kiosks, mini markets and hotels, with prior Immigration approval
quote: All international students studying at public or private higher education institutions are allowed to work part-time for a maximum of 20 hours per week ONLY during semester breaks or holidays of more than 7 days at restaurants, petrol kiosks, mini markets and hotels as long as their student passes remain valid. Please note that prior approval from the Department of Immigration is required.

claim: Students may not work as cashiers, nor in hotels as singers, masseurs, musicians or GROs (guest relations officers), nor in any immoral job
quote: International students are NOT permitted to work as cashiers. In addition, in the hotel sector, international students are NOT allowed to work as singers, masseurs, musicians or GROs (Guest Relation Officers). International students are not allowed to engage in any job or activity deemed to be immoral.

claim: Part-time work applications go through the student's institution, and the student must be present with an institution representative at the Immigration Department
quote: Applications to work part time must be made through the educational institution at which the international students are enrolled. The international student needs to be present with the representative of the education institution at the Immigration Department of Malaysia in order to submit an application for part time work.

claim: Except for mobility programmes, international students may only enrol full-time, and only in one full-time degree at a time
quote: Under current rules, except for mobility programmes, international students can only enrol for full-time courses.

claim: International students need at least 12 years of education and a national or international exam recognised for diploma or degree admission
quote: International students must have at least twelve (12) years of education and have undergone a national/international examination recognized by the Ministry of Education for the purpose of admission to diploma or degree programmes.

claim: The Graduate Pass (one year's stay after graduation) is open only to 32 listed nationalities; Bangladesh is not one of them
quote: Applicants from the following countries are eligible: Australia, Bahrain, Brunei, Cambodia, Canada, China, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, India, Indonesia, Japan, Kuwait, Laos, Myanmar, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Oman, Philippines, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Thailand, UAE, United Kingdom, USA, and Vietnam.

claim: New Student Pass documents: one 35mm x 45mm photo on a white background; passport data page, pages with visas and the observation page; offer letter; Health Declaration Form; academic certificates and transcripts; English test certificate
quote: 1 passport size photograph with WHITE background (35mm x 45mm).

claim: The passport must be valid for at least 18 months; for a one-off pass EMGS recommends validity 12 months longer than the course
quote: Passport validity duration must be 18 months and above. Note: For one-off Student Pass applications, the recommended validity is 12 months longer than the duration of study.

claim: An offer letter is needed; online applicants can only submit after receiving the letter of acceptance or offer
quote: If you are making an online application, you will only be able to fill out the form and submit an application once you have received a letter of acceptance/offer from your university/college.

claim: A Health Declaration Form must be filled in and uploaded
quote: You will be required to fill up and submit a copy of the health declaration form to apply for a student visa in Malaysia.

claim: Immigration requires institutions to sign a personal bond for each student; the institution asks the student to lodge the amount, which is returned on completion or withdrawal if no immigration law was broken
quote: To comply with this requirement, the institution will require you to lodge the specified amount for this purpose. This money will be returned to you upon completion or withdrawal of your study in the institution, on condition that there is no violation of any provision of the Immigration laws of Malaysia.

claim: Accepted English tests include MUET, IELTS, TOEFL iBT, TOEFL Essentials, PTE Academic, Cambridge English, Linguaskill, OET and ELS CIEP; without an English certificate the application may be delayed and the pass will not cover the full course
quote: If you do not attach your English language certificate when creating your VAL application, your application processing may be delayed. In addition, you will also not be eligible to receive a student pass for the full duration of your course.

claim: To renew a Student Pass the student needs a CGPA of at least 2.0 and overall attendance of at least 80%; otherwise the institution must submit an explanation letter
quote: You must achieve a CGPA of at least 2.0 in order to renew your student pass. Your overall attendance must also be at least 80% in order to renew your student pass. If you fail to meet any of the above requirements, your institution will be required to submit an explanation letter to support your renewal application.

claim: A change of course or institution (Variation) needs a clearance or release letter, or a completion letter, from the previous institution
quote: A clearance/release letter from the previous Educational Institution will be required. A letter of completion issued by the previous Educational Institution will also be accepted.

claim: Bangladesh is on EMGS's list of countries whose students need a Single Entry Visa before entering Malaysia
quote: The following is the list of countries that requires a Single Entry Visa prior to entering Malaysia - Afghanistan - Albania - Algeria - Angola - Argentina - Armenia - Austria - Azerbaijan - Bahrain - Bangladesh

quote: EMGS will not be able to initiate the process of student pass endorsement and supporting letter issuance for sticker endorsement purposes in the event that the international students fail to undergo the in-country screening.

claim: Students renewing a pass do not need in-country medical screening; Variation and Progression students need it if their last screening was more than 90 days earlier
quote: International students who are renewing their student passes are not required to attend in-country medical screening

quote: You must provide a personal bond with a Malaysian citizen as your sponsor, who must have a minimum monthly salary of RM 1,500.

quote: International students whose medical and health insurance cover period expires prior to the expiry of their existing student pass are required to top up/extend their insurance.

claim: The first-year EMGS processing fee and the eVAL fee are not refundable once invoiced; immigration fees are refunded only if the pass was not issued or was rejected
quote: The Processing Fee paid for the first year and eVAL Processing Fee are not refundable once the application is invoiced.

claim: Students can claim a refund only for applications they created and paid themselves on the Education Malaysia website, not for applications created by the institution

claim: ISAC KLIA T1 is in the Arrival Hall, main terminal Level 3, before the immigration counters; T2 is at Level 3A after the Skybridge exit

claim: PLKS workers may not change sector or employer without Home Ministry permission
quote: Pekerja Asing tidak boleh bertukar sektor pekerjaan atau bertukar majikan tanpa mendapat kebenaran daripada Kementerian Dalam Negeri.

claim: PLKS workers are not allowed to marry local residents or other foreign workers in Malaysia
